title: Ter
author: Jeremy B.
desc: Transform your upper body strength with the Ter program, a focused 2-week training plan designed for those ready to elevate their fitness. Committing just two days a week, you'll engage in targeted exercises like the Lying Reverse Fly to develop your rear delts and upper back, ensuring balanced muscle growth. Each workout is structured for optimal intensity, helping you build endurance and power effectively. Get ready to sculpt and strengthen your back with confidence!
